m: aupaniṣada mf(ī)n. contained or taught in an Upaniṣad, ŚBr. xiv; MuṇḍUp.; ŚāṅkhGṛ.; Mn. vi, 29, &c.
a follower of the Upaniṣads, a Vedāntin Comm. on Bādar. ii, 2, 10.
a: aupaniṣada a. (dī f.) [upaniṣad-aṇ] 1 Contained or taught in an Upaniṣad; scriptural, theological. 2 Based or founded on, derived from, the Upaniṣads; aupaniṣadaṃ darśanaṃ (another name for Vedānta phil.) — daḥ 1 The supreme soul, Brahman. 2 A follower of the doctrines of the Upaniṣads.
